notes.title: Tinboy - Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

The publisher has changed. ːsteamhappyː
We recovered Tinboy after 3 years and we decided to update the game and also bring it to [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/tinboy-switch]Nintendo Switch[/url] and [url=https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/p/tinboy/9pjnxwl6ql2j]Xbox One[/url].
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9989729/9aa39f7115b5f8f5126df81d2c64856fe1b44237.gif[/img]
What's in this update:
[list]
[*] Improved controls
[*] Controller Support
[*] Achievements
[*] Mac & Linux version
[*] New languages
[/list]

Also please check out our latest game: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/747360/Gray_Dawn/]Gray Dawn[/url] - The adventure of a cursed priest

Thank you :)
